features.intro: As a maneuver, a creature [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to an arrow launcher can make an **Agility test**.
features.name: Deactivate

tiers.high: The arrow launcher is deactivated and can't be used.
tiers.low: The creature accidentally activates the **Arrow Storm** ability.
tiers.mid: The arrow launcher is deactivated but the creature is [slowed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/slowed) (EoT).

features.name: Arrow Storm

sections.label: Effect
sections.text: This ability can't be used again until the arrow launcher is reloaded.

features.target: Each creature and object in the area

sections.label: Effect
sections.text: The arrow launcher is reloaded, allowing **Arrow Storm** to be used again. This action can be used only once per round.

sections.label: Effect
sections.text: The next use of **Arrow Storm** gains an edge and has a +10 bonus to ranged distance. This action can be used only once per round.

sections.label: Effect
sections.text: The arrow launcher and the creature using this action move together up to 3 squares.

features.body:
**Flaming Arrows (+1 EV) Arrow Storm** deals fire damage, and can ignite flammable objects in its area.

**Screamers (+3 EV)** The arrows make a high-pitched screaming noise as they are fired and descend onto their targets. The **Screamers** ability replaces **Arrow Storm**.
features.name: Upgrades
Screamers

sections.label: Effect
sections.text: This ability can't be used again until the arrow launcher is reloaded.

features.target: Each creature and object in the area

flavor: A small wooden cart uses alchemical rockets to launch up to a hundred arrows at a time across a wide area.
name: Arrow Launcher
